store.name: Pepperkite
store.tagline: Big crunch, bright flavor, a little kick.
store.voice: Bright, cheeky and upbeat, like the friend who always brings the best snacks to the party. Short, punchy sentences; concrete flavor words (tangy, smoky, puckery, a slow cayenne glow); at most one kite or crunch pun per paragraph. Loud about flavor, plain and precise about ingredients, allergens and heat. Confident and warm, never snarky or shouty, no ALL CAPS.
store.story: Pepperkite began in 2021 when two friends, Rosie and Jun, sold hot honey popcorn from a folding table at a windy kite festival in Columbus, Ohio, and were sold out by noon. They kept the name the festival crowd gave the stand. Today a small team seasons everything twice (once warm, once right before packing) in a Columbus kitchen and packs fresh batches every Tuesday. Range: popcorn, crunchy chickpeas and nuts, chips and crackers, candy and chocolate, hot sauces and shakers, snack boxes, a monthly Snack Club and a little merch.

policies.refund:
Snacks should make you happy. If a flavor is not your thing, tell us within 30 days of delivery at hello@pepperkite.example and we will send a different flavor or refund it to your original payment method, even if the bag is open (we really do want to know what missed).

Anything that arrives crushed, stale or melted gets replaced free; a photo helps. Merch can be returned unused within 30 days for a full refund. Snack Club boxes that have already shipped cannot be returned, but you can skip, pause or cancel before the 1st of any month from your account.

Refunds are issued within 5 business days of approval.
policies.shipping:
We pack orders Monday to Thursday in Columbus, Ohio, and most leave within 2 business days.

  • Standard shipping to the US and Canada: a flat $6, free on orders over $45.
  • US orders usually arrive in 3–5 business days; Canadian orders in 5–10.
  • Canadian orders may owe import duties or taxes on delivery.
  • Chocolate and chocolate-drizzled snacks ship with an ice pack from May to September.

Snack Club boxes pack on the first Tuesday of each month and always ship free.
policies.privacy:
Pepperkite collects only what we need to send your snacks and, if you ask, our news: your name, email, shipping address, order history and any allergy notes you share. Payments are handled by our payment provider; we never see or store your full card number.

We never sell or rent your information. You can unsubscribe from our emails with one click, and ask us to see, correct or delete what we hold by writing to hello@pepperkite.example.
policies.terms:
These terms cover purchases from the Pepperkite online shop. Prices are in US dollars; taxes and any duties are calculated at checkout or on delivery. Product photos are styled, so your popcorn may land a little differently.

Snack Club subscriptions renew on their schedule until you skip, pause or cancel them from your account before the 1st of the month. Allergen information is listed on every product; if you have a severe allergy, please read it carefully, since our kitchen handles peanuts, tree nuts, milk, soy, wheat and sesame.

Questions? Write to hello@pepperkite.example or call (614) 555-0137, Monday to Friday, 9am to 5pm Eastern.

art_direction: Bold, bright, high-energy snack photography for a playful snack brand. Hard direct flash with crisp, short, hard-edged shadows and a glossy pop on every surface. Saturated solid-color seamless paper backdrops in the brand palette: vermilion red-orange (#d63513), sunshine yellow (#ffc93c), blush pink (#ffe0d4), warm sand (#f6f1e8) and deep inky purple-navy (#1d1630); flavor colors (pickle green, lime, sky blue) only as small accents. Playful, graphic compositions: tidy overhead flat-lays, snacks floating and tumbling mid-air, one pouch, jar, bottle or box standing hero-center with pieces spilling around it. Packaging is plain: matte pouches, bags, boxes, jars, wrappers and bottles in solid colors, blank or with simple abstract shapes only (circles, stripes, a kite-shaped diamond). Real-photo style, crisp focus, 50 mm lens look, the product fully in frame with room around it so square and round crops keep it. Mood: cheeky, joyful, loud and appetizing. Avoid: any text, letters, numbers, logos, brand marks, nutrition panels or labels with writing; faces or people; muted, pastel-washed or dark moody looks; wooden tables and rustic props; clutter; watermarks; vignettes.

products.name: Hot Honey Popcorn
products.description_html:
Our first flavor and still the one people text us about. Sweet wildflower honey, a slow cayenne burn and a pinch of flaky salt on big, crunchy mushroom kernels.

Flavor

Honey-sweet up front, a warm cayenne glow in the middle, salty at the finish. Mild heat that builds just enough to make you reach for the next handful.

Ingredients

Popcorn, cane sugar, wildflower honey, sunflower oil, sea salt, cayenne pepper, smoked paprika.

Allergens

Contains none of the top 9 allergens. Made in our Columbus kitchen, which also handles peanuts, tree nuts, milk, soy, wheat and sesame.

Good to know

  • About 140 calories per 1 oz serving; 5 servings per bag.
  • Gluten-free. Contains honey, so not vegan.
  • Best within 3 months; reseal the bag to keep the crunch.

pages.title: Our story
pages.content_html:
Pepperkite started on a windy Saturday in 2021 at a kite festival in Columbus, Ohio. Two friends, Rosie and Jun, set up a folding table with a few hundred bags of hot honey popcorn and a hand-painted sign. They were sold out by noon. The crowd started calling the stand "the pepper kite place", and the name stuck.

Seasoned twice, always

Every batch gets seasoned while it is still warm, so the flavor bakes on, then again right before it is bagged, so the first handful tastes as loud as the last. It takes longer. It is worth it.

Small batches, every Tuesday

We cook in one kitchen on the east side of Columbus and pack fresh batches every Tuesday, so nothing sits in a warehouse getting sad. When a flavor sells out, it sells out; the good ones come back.

What we care about

  • Real ingredients you can pronounce: honey, cheddar, chilies, lime, sea salt.
  • Plain allergen facts on every product, because snacks should be fun for everyone who can eat them.
  • Heat you can choose: every product has a heat level, from no heat to Afterburner.
  • Packaging that recycles or composts wherever we can make it work.

Today we are a team of nine, still flying kites on windy Saturdays, still arguing about whether dill pickle beats hot honey. (It does not. Or it does. Try both.)

pages.title: FAQ
pages.content_html:
How spicy is "Hot"?

Every product has a heat level: No heat, Mild, Medium, Hot and Extra hot. Mild is a warm glow, Hot is a proper kick, and Extra hot (Afterburner) is for people who already know they love it. New to heat? Start with Green Light Hot Sauce or Hot Honey Popcorn.

Is your kitchen allergen-free?

No. Our Columbus kitchen handles peanuts, tree nuts, milk, soy, wheat and sesame. Each product lists exactly what it contains, and we clean thoroughly between batches, but we cannot promise there is no cross-contact.

Which snacks are vegan or gluten-free?

Most of them. Use the Dietary filter on any category page to show only vegan, gluten-free, dairy-free or peanut-free snacks.

How does the Snack Club work?

You get a box of eight full-size snacks every month (or every two months), including one members-only test flavor. It ships free, and you can skip, pause or cancel from your account any time before the 1st.

How long do snacks stay fresh?

Popcorn and chips are best within 3 months, nuts and chickpeas within 6, candy and chocolate within 9. Each bag shows a best-by date.

Do you ship outside the US and Canada?

Not yet. We are working on it, one very carefully packed box at a time.

posts.title: Why we season everything twice
posts.content_html:
Ask anyone who has worked a Tuesday shift in our kitchen what the job is, and they will say: "Season it. Then season it again." Here is why.

Round one: while it is warm

Popcorn, chickpeas and chips come out of the kettle or oven still hot, and that is when seasoning sticks best. The oil is warm, the surface is a little tacky, and the flavor bakes right on. This is where the base flavor lives: the salt, the sweet, the tang.

Round two: right before the bag

Once everything has cooled, we toss it again with a lighter, brighter dusting: fresh dill, lime, a little more cayenne. Cool snacks hold these delicate flavors without cooking them flat, so the first handful tastes as loud as the last.

Why not just use more seasoning once?

We tried. Pile it all on at once and half of it ends up at the bottom of the bag as dust. Two lighter coats cling better, taste brighter and leave your fingers only moderately orange.

It takes longer, and it is the whole point. Taste it for yourself with a bag of Hot Honey Popcorn.

posts.title: Build a game-night snack board in five minutes
posts.content_html:
A snack board is just a big plate with a plan. Here is ours, ready before anyone finds the dice.

1. Start with a crunchy anchor

Pour a big pile of Hot Honey Popcorn in one corner. It is the crowd-pleaser, so put it where everyone can reach.

2. Add something salty and sharp

Fan out Firecracker Kettle Chips and a stack of Cheddar Cornbread Crackers next to a small bowl of Crunchy Chili Crisp for dipping.

3. Fill the gaps with little things

Chili Lime Peanuts and Crunchy Chickpeas go in the corners and every empty space. They make the board look full and disappear first.

4. Something sweet to finish

Knot a few Sour Kite Tails and snap a Salty Pretzel Crunch Bar into squares. Lay them across the middle for color.

5. A sauce for the brave

Set out Green Light for everyone and a tiny dish of Afterburner with a warning flag. Someone will try it. Someone always does.

Short on time? The Party Box has nearly all of it in one go.

posts.title: The heat ladder: from Green Light to Afterburner
posts.content_html:
Every Pepperkite snack has a heat level, so you can climb as high as you like and stop whenever you want. Here is the ladder, rung by rung.

No heat

All flavor, zero burn: Dill Pickle Popcorn, Everything Bagel Almonds, Lime & Sea Salt Plantain Chips and every chocolate bar.

Mild

A warm glow that fades fast. Start with Hot Honey Popcorn or Green Light Hot Sauce, which is mostly tangy tomatillo and herbs.

Medium

You will notice it, and you will want more. Chili Lime Peanuts, White Cheddar Jalapeño Popcorn and our Crunchy Chili Crisp live here.

Hot

A proper kick that sticks around for a minute. Tailwind Hot Sauce and Firecracker Kettle Chips: fruity and smoky first, then the habanero shows up.

Extra hot

Afterburner, our ghost pepper and pineapple sauce. One drop, then wait. Keep a glass of milk or a spoon of yogurt nearby; water just moves the fire around.

Want the whole climb in one go? The Heat Seeker Box lines up six of them, mild to wild.
